description:
## Why

`Interactive.state.transcript :: [entry]` is a flat list. Every streaming chunk does `List.replace_at(transcript, idx, updated)` — O(N) cells allocated even though only one slot's contents change. Order is fully stable; entries are append-only with one mutable slot at a time.

Extract a `Transcript` module that owns the render state. Interactive holds `transcript: %Transcript{}` and orchestrates only.

## Depends on

- `opi-4dx.6` — block-id-keyed events from the agent (the same shape recurses inside an AssistantMessage in `.9`).

## Shape

```
%OctoPi.TUI.Transcript{
  order:     [id, ...],          # newest-head; append by `[id | order]`
  data:      %{id => entry},     # current content for every entry; lives forever
  renderers: %{id => renderer},  # only present for entries currently streaming
  rendered:  %{id => iolist}     # cached output for everything ever rendered
}
```

API:

- `new() :: t`
- `append(t, id, entry) :: t` — new entry, fresh renderer, empty rendered slot
- `update(t, id, entry) :: t` — chunk arrived: update data, push into renderer
- `finalize(t, id, entry) :: t` — drain renderer, drop from `renderers`, store final output in `rendered`
- `render(t, theme, width) :: {iolist, t}` — for each id (tail-first walk of `order`), run pending tail in renderer if present, append produced segments to `rendered[id]`, emit nested iolist tree
- `resize(t, theme, width) :: t` — clear `rendered`, rebuild `renderers` from `data`, re-render once

Entry-level renderer is a behaviour: at minimum `Markdown.Render.t()` (assistant text), plus thinking/tool/etc entry types. The Transcript module doesn't know about entry kinds — it dispatches via the renderer's `put`/`finalize`/`to_iolist` API.

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1685-1714` — `apply_partial` / `finalize_assistant` mutations to migrate.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1716-1740` — `finalize_assistant` body.
- Render call site to migrate: search for `transcript.render` telemetry span in `interactive.ex`.

## Acceptance

- `Transcript.append/3` on N entries does O(1) work per call; no spine rebuilds (verifiable by absence of `++` / `Enum.reverse` on hot paths).
- `Transcript.render/3` after a single chunk update on the streaming entry does O(pending tail) work for that entry and O(1) per other entry (just emits cached iolist).
- All transcript mutations on `Interactive` go through `Transcript` API; the GenServer state holds nothing else about rendering.

## Tests

- Pure unit tests: append-update-finalize-render lifecycle; resize correctness; rendered content stays byte-equal across renders if data didn't change.
- Property-style: appending N entries and updating each k times produces a transcript whose rendered output equals what a from-scratch render would produce.

## Out of scope

- Per-message recursion (`.9`); this ticket is the transcript level only.
- Wiring into `Interactive` (`.10`); this ticket builds the module standalone.
title: Transcript module: stable-cell render state
